opportunity.title: DHA PAE DMS EIDS PMO Data Exchange Services Operations, Modernization, and Development (AOI 02)
opportunity.noticeType: Solicitation (Commercial Solutions Opening area of interest)
opportunity.description: Defense Health Agency PAE Digital Medical Solutions, EIDS PMO, seeks commercial solutions for Data Exchange Platform (DxP) operations, sustainment, modernization and development. The DxP processes real-time clinical and operational data exchanged with more than 15 external systems and partners and enables secure, standards-based interoperability among DHA, the Department of Veterans Affairs and other federal healthcare partners. The Government wants reliable, secure, continuously available legacy services while modernizing toward scalable, cloud-native, API-driven, standards-based and AI/ML-ready capabilities. Issued under DHA Commercial Solutions Opening HT003826SC005. No set-aside used.

rationale.point: No small-business set-aside means full-and-open competition against large, established DoD health IT contractors.
Company has no prior VA, DoD, or HHS prime contracts, while buyer is Defense Health Agency's PAE for Digital Medical Solutions overseeing EIDS PMO.
Opportunity requires AI/ML-enabled, cloud-native API solutions with estimated value $500K+, but company's past projects are each under $500K and AI/ML capability is unverified.
Company lacks facility clearance and SOC 2 report, likely required for DoD health data work in Rosslyn, VA.

risks: No facility clearance for DoD work
No SOC 2 compliance for cloud-native requirements
No federal prime past performance in health IT
Team of six may lack capacity for sustained PMO support
Full-and-open competition with no set-aside protection
nextSteps: Consider subcontracting to a prime with DoD health IT experience
Pursue facility clearance and SOC 2 certification for future DoD opportunities
Build federal past performance through smaller set-aside contracts first
